definitions: A type of chocolate dessert or confectionery that contains an exceptionally high amount of chocolate or cocoa, often implying a richer and more intense flavour.
A flavour or style of ice cream, cake, or other sweet treat that is extra rich in chocolate.
examples: She ordered a slice of double fudge cake.
The double fudge brownie was incredibly dense.
They launched a new double fudge ice cream flavour.
